purpose: Teach: ジュン/純一郎/愛子/めぐみ/幸子/直樹/哲也/ディック

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジュンくんのご両親と話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad had a talk with Jun's parents.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle opening. Speaking as if sharing something quietly important. A hint of tenderness toward her son's concern. Calm, even pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと小泉純一郎元首相の歴史番組観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a history show about former Prime Minister Koizumi with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager rush of the words. No hesitation — wants to share immediately. Quick pace, genuine delight in the memory. Slight rise at the end like offering it for approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが皇室の愛子様の御成長を喜ばれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying how happy he is seeing Princess Aiko growing up.
lines.style: Reflective, thoughtful pacing. Slightly distant, as if recalling what he said. Warm undertone — appreciative of her husband's gentleness. Quiet certainty in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとめぐみちゃんと公園で遊んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I played in the park with Dad and Megumi.
lines.style: Guileless happiness. Quick, unburdened delivery. The simple joy of stating a fact. Open, unguarded tone. Slight brightness lingering at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「幸子伯母さんが来られる」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad mentioned that your Aunt Sachiko is coming to visit.
lines.style: Measured, informative tone. Speaking as if relaying a household detail she's turning over in her mind. Slight pause before 'Sachiko' — considerate. Calm, even rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと直樹おじさんと釣り行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went fishing with Dad and Uncle Naoki.
lines.style: Bright, proud disclosure. Quick tempo, genuine excitement in the memory. A child savoring something he did with the adults he trusts. Light, unburdened delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと哲也さんが釣り仲間でいらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad and Tetsuya are fishing buddies.
lines.style: Observational, slightly warm. Pacing is gentle and assured. Speaking as if this connection pleases her — a small, steady fact about the men she cares for. Quiet satisfaction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「ディック・ヴァン・ダイク」の古い喜劇観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I watched an old Dick Van Dyke comedy together.
lines.style: Eager, animated ending. Bright tempo throughout. The joy of sharing something silly and old with his father. Slight rise in energy as he names the film. Genuine, unguarded delight.
